review_method.unit: root, direct parent, canonical ledger, assigned reply function, rendered reply, and ordered recent thread context

case_reviews.note: Short pile-on signal naturally amplifies the root request without adding facts.
Preserves discomfort while explicitly requesting source and original context.
A concise evidence request that remains within the canonical uncertainty boundary.
Directly requests an authoritative public explanation and reads like a local reply.
The 'career bible' metaphor is recognizable light irony aimed at an idea, not a person.
Coherent and safe, but behaves partly as another evidence request rather than pure clarification.
A genuinely short signal-only turn that does not reopen the full argument.
Natural and stance-preserving, but its speech function leans emotional support rather than amplification.
The evidence-request function is correct, but the target shifts from feedback-status follow-up to the original text.
First-person evidence-status relay avoids turning absence of visible evidence into an objective claim.
Personal experience is specific enough to be recognizable while remaining synthetic and non-identifying.
Brief emotional support directly follows the prior experience turn and closes the local thread naturally.

observed_data_interpretation.finding: All four target interaction functions occur in both the comparable reference sample and the held-out lecture sample. Their inclusion is data-supported, while the 12-case synthetic mix deliberately over-samples them for coverage and is not a frequency calibration.

claim_boundary.next_gate: Do not scale to all 48 agents until clarification-versus-request and amplification-versus-support are separated in a larger 24-to-36-reply audit.
